content: Furthermore, we compare the correlation between inter-annotator agreement and difficulty scores in the training data. Given that the majority of sentences do not contain a PICO span, we only include in these calculations those that contain a reference label. Pearson's r are 0.34, 0.30 and 0.31 for p, i and o, respectively, confirming that inter-worker agreement and our proposed difficulty score are quite distinct.
